mapper.select: SELECT * FROM boards b LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = b.user_id WHERE b.board_id = #{boardId}

SELECT c.comment_id, c.board_id, c.user_id, u.nickname AS user_nickname, c.content, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM board_comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.user_id WHERE c.board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY c.comment_id
SELECT image_id, board_id, image_url, original_name, saved_name, created_at FROM board_images WHERE board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY image_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO boards ( user_id, title, content, content_type, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{contentType}, NOW(), NOW() )
INSERT INTO board_comments( board_id, user_id, content, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES( #{boardId}, #{userId}, #{content}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE boards SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, content_type = #{contentType}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE board_id = #{boardId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM board_comments WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND comment_id = #{commentId}
DELETE FROM board_images WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND image_id = #{imageId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_images ( board_id, image_url, original_name, saved_name, created_at ) VALUES ( #{boardId}, #{imageUrl}, #{originalName}, #{savedName}, NOW() )
